"Create a lightweight, web-playable 3D Action Battle Royale game optimized for mobile-style performance, heavily inspired by Free Fire. 

1. Core Gameplay Loop @COMMENT_BODY@ Mechanics:
- Single-player vs. Bots: The player faces off against AI enemies on a contained island map.
- Drop Phase: Start the game with the player parachuting or gliding down onto the map from above.
- Looting System: Spawn specific weapons (Assault Rifle, Shotgun, Pistol), ammunition, and health medkits across the floor inside and around structures. Walking over or interacting with items adds them to the player inventory.
- Gunplay @COMMENT_BODY@ Combat: Third-person perspective (TPP) with a responsive mobile-friendly layout. Controls must include Move Joystick, Aim/Look, Shoot, Aim-Down-Sights (ADS/Scope), Crouch, Jump, and Reload.
- Shrinking Safe Zone: A radiant \"Danger Zone\" circle that shrinks over time. Players caught outside the safe zone take progressive damage over time.

2. Visual Style @COMMENT_BODY@ World Design:
- Art Style: Low-poly, vibrant 3D aesthetic ensuring smooth frame rates.
- Environment: A tropical or desert island map featuring scattered structures (houses, metal containers, walls for cover) and natural terrain obstacles (trees, grass, rocks).
- UI/HUD: Mobile-inspired overlay displaying a minimap with safe zone boundaries, an active player health bar, current weapon ammo counts, a button to trigger medkits, and a live counter of remaining alive enemies.

3. Game State @COMMENT_BODY@ Win/Loss Conditions:
- Winning: Eliminate all enemy bots to trigger a victory screen celebrating \"Booyah!\" or \"Victory!\".
- Losing: Player health drops to 0, showing a \"Game Over\" screen with a \"Restart Match\" button. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Built **Wildside: Island Royale** in `index.html` as a lightweight, browser-playable 3D battle royale. It includes a low-poly island, a gliding drop-in, seven AI rivals, weapon and medkit pickups, a shrinking damage zone, a minimap and HUD, touch controls, and victory/game-over restart screens.

To play, serve the project directory with a local web server and open it in a browser. Controls: **WASD** to move, **mouse** to aim and fire, **Space** to jump, **E** to pick up loot, and **R** to reload; mobile players can use the on-screen joystick and buttons.

Assumption: implemented as a single-player match against seven bots, with simplified bot AI and no external assets beyond Three.js. Verified the game renders and starts in Chromium; the browser console showed a missing favicon request.
